name: BBBC001v1: structured review loop versus vanilla Astra
working_tree: Clean committed inference runtime; new report protocol generated before live calls.
selection: All six published images, in annotation-file order; no exclusions.
split_note: BBBC001 has no official train/test split. 'test' is a local Harbor routing label only.
task: Published cell-counting task; identical neutral instruction for every image and mode.
primary_metric: Mean over all six images of 100 * abs(prediction - mean(two human counts)) / mean(two human counts); lower is better.
missing_policy: No official full-dataset score if any prediction is missing, negative, nonfinite or an error. Show coverage and answered-subset error separately; do not rank partial scores against complete scores.
preprocessing: Lossless 8-bit grayscale TIFF to RGB PNG by channel replication. No resize, contrast adjustment, denoising, annotation overlays or synthetic pixels.
leakage: Only PNG and question enter the agent environment; counts, original filenames, source URLs and dataset metadata stay in verifier/report. Prior model exposure to this public dataset cannot be ruled out.
limitations: Only six images from one experiment, not broad multimodal evidence.
Published human counts disagree; their mean is the reference, not an exact biological truth.
Current OpenCV tools are color/white-background tools, not microscopy segmentation models.
Independent plans and different compute per mode prevent a clean causal estimate of Jev selection alone.
This is a retest of previously inspected benchmark images after integration fixes.
Incomplete modes receive a completion rate and answered-subset error, not a fabricated full-benchmark error.
No changes during this run. One attempt per mode per image; no claims of a stable overall ranking.
The variant jointly changes feedback, acceptance checks, retry budget and repeat detection; it does not isolate one component causally.
Numerical proposals before review are diagnostic and do not replace rejected final answers.
license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; images and ground truth by David Root and Anne Carpenter.
attribution: BBBC001v1, Moffat et al. (Cell, 2006), Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection; Ljosa et al. (Nature Methods, 2012).
user_scope: Try structured Jev feedback to Astra planning and Jev selection, with bounded retries. Both Jev stages remain enabled.
prior_exposure: All six images were inspected during preceding experiments. This is a retest of the complete published cohort, not a fresh held-out evaluation.

loop_changes.acceptance: Overall support AND all four checks >= 0.75
loop_changes.duplicate_operations: Reuse cached evidence; reject plans consisting only of previously attempted effective operations.
loop_changes.observation_novelty: Exact measurement and artifact-hash/coordinate comparison, not semantic proof.
loop_changes.candidate_scoring: Report first and last proposed numerical counts separately from final accepted answers; no best-of-N selection.
